name: Fisherman
ability: Once per game, during the day, visit the Storyteller for some advice to help your team win.
wakes: Never at night. Once per game during the day the Fisherman may visit the Storyteller.
interaction: The Storyteller privately gives one piece of advice (preferably what to do, e.g. 'execute X', 'trust Y') that would help the Fisherman's team win if followed. Then mark No ability.
drunk_or_poisoned: The Storyteller may give bad advice; the ability is still spent.

rulings.text: The Fisherman chooses when to use it; the Storyteller chooses the advice.
Advice is strategy, not necessarily fact.
If drunk or poisoned, the Storyteller may give bad advice.
The Fisherman may ask for the advice to be repeated, but no extra context is added.

test_scenarios.name: good advice
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Fisherman, Bob Imp, Carol Empath poisoned by Dan Poisoner.
test_scenarios.expected: Advice such as 'Don't trust Carol' or 'Execute Bob'; Alice gets No ability.

test_scenarios.name: drunk fisherman
test_scenarios.setup: Eve is the Drunk believing she is the Fisherman; Lewis Chef (good).
test_scenarios.expected: Storyteller may say 'Execute Lewis' (bad advice); Eve marked No ability.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned fisherman
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Fisherman poisoned by Dan Poisoner; Bob Imp.
test_scenarios.expected: Storyteller may give advice that harms good, e.g. 'Trust Bob'.
